searchText: Anyone strictly opposed to making blob txs transaction type 0x03? (0x03 was initially reserved for 3074 afaik, so no loss there). Would be good to not have gaps I recall 0x03 was being used for something else in Erigon; Starkware I think? But I believe erigon has been removing it's non-Eth chain support so maybe not an issue. Just took a look and appears that code has been removed.
